verification: Scheduler terminal state, exit codes, node architecture, executable digest, raw-data digest, independent fixture decompression and validate_loop.py checks passed.
limitations: The reported per-input times exclude node, scheduler and process startup, but include independent libbzip2 stream initialization and allocation.
Ascending prefixes are zero-heavy above one byte; the pseudorandom proxy is a sensitivity comparison, not a proven IID population sample.
Only the one-byte population is fully covered by every repeated loop. Larger populations are extrapolations.
Allocated-node billing and scheduler elapsed time are not used as per-input timings.
No multi-worker or multi-node speedup is inferred from the single-worker measurements.
